### Problem

The report in #598 describes a defect, and the reproduction confirmed it: a Python test written from the report fails on the default branch at `7f4b2f88357dacf434f95ae74d800accf62da885` (https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/41348994584).

Reproduction test: `tests/repro/test_issue_598.py`, SHA-256 `bf563525c730141b58c406ea4df4d198049f9bdcc9e7347345af6c57a1a69a62`, on the branch `test/repro-issue-598`.

Reproduction way: `python`, run by scripts/repro-run.sh as `{"junit":"build/dx-repro-junit.xml","minutes":10,"run":"PYTHONPATH=\"$PWD/.dx-pytest\" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --rootdir=. -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml=build/dx-repro-junit.xml tests/repro/test_issue_598.py","setup":["python3 -m pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --target .dx-pytest pytest==9.1.1 PyYAML==6.0.3"],"test":"tests/repro/test_issue_598.py"}`.

The test is the specification: it asserts what the report expected. It was written from an outsider's text, so it runs only the way it was written, in the reproduction's sandbox (scripts/repro-run.sh: the way's setup before the test is in the tree, then the test alone as a user of its own, with no environment, no secrets and no network but the machine's), never in the autopilot's working tree.

### Scope

- Fix the defect the reproduction test exercises, in the code it exercises.
- Add the reproduction test to the default branch, exactly as written.

### Out of scope

- Changing, moving, skipping or deleting the reproduction test: it is the evidence, and gate G7 checks its SHA-256.
- Any other behaviour the report mentions that the test does not exercise: a new issue.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given the reproduction test tests/repro/test_issue_598.py exactly as written, when it runs on the fix, then it passes, where it failed on 7f4b2f88357d.
